Based on my search, here's how to log in to your **My Service Canada Account (MSCA)**:

## Official Login Page

Go to the official MSCA website: **https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/services/my-account.html**

## Three Ways to Sign In

You have three options to access your account:

| Method | What You Need |
|--------|-------------|
| **1. GCKey** | A Government of Canada username and password you create |
| **2. Interac® Sign-In Partner** | Your existing online banking credentials from participating Canadian banks |
| **3. Provincial Digital ID** | Alberta.ca Account or BC Services Card (only for residents of Alberta and British Columbia) |

## If You're a New User

You'll need to register first. Before starting, gather:
- Your **Social Insurance Number (SIN)**
- **Date of birth**
- **Mother's maiden name**
- **Current postal code**
- A **Personal Access Code (PAC)** or **EI Access Code** (mailed to you in 5-10 business days if you don't have one)

## What You Can Access Through MSCA

- Employment Insurance (EI) claims and reports
- Canada Pension Plan (CPP) and CPP Disability
- Old Age Security (OAS) and Guaranteed Income Supplement (GIS)
- Canadian Dental Care Plan (CDCP)
- National Student Loans Service Centre (NSLSC) account
- Tax slips (T4E, T4A(P), T4A(OAS))
- Direct deposit and personal information updates

## Important Notes

- **Maintenance**: MSCA is unavailable from 12 am to 7 am (ET) on some Saturdays
- **Security**: Service Canada will never ask for your password or personal information via email or text messages
- **Student loans**: As of May 25, 2025, NSLSC accounts are now accessed through MSCA instead of the old NSLSC login

If you need help, you can request a Personal Access Code (PAC) online or contact Service Canada directly.

---

**Sources:**

1. https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/services/my-account.html
2. https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/services/my-account/province.html
3. https://www.canada.ca/en/government/sign-in-online-account.html
4. https://www.insurdinary.ca/my-service-canada-account-guide/
5. https://davidsklar.com/blog/osap-login-changed-how-to-access-your-student-loan-through-my-service-canada-account/
